name: TogglyCreateRelease
description: Create a new Toggly release with release notes and feature changes
helpMarkDown: Creates a new release in Toggly. The release can include feature flag changes and release notes. [Learn more](https://docs.toggly.io/integrations/azure-devops)
author: Toggly

inputs.name: connectedService
inputs.label: Toggly Service Connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: Select a Toggly service connection. If you haven't created one, click 'Manage' to create a new service connection.

inputs.name: applicationId
inputs.label: Application ID
inputs.helpMarkDown: The Toggly application ID where the release will be created

inputs.name: releaseName
inputs.label: Release Name
inputs.helpMarkDown: Name of the release. You can use Azure DevOps variables like $(Build.BuildNumber)

inputs.name: releaseNotes
inputs.label: Release Notes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional release notes in markdown format

inputs.name: featureChanges
inputs.label: Feature Changes (JSON)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Optional JSON array of feature changes. Format: [{"flagKey":"my-feature","toState":[{"name":"AlwaysOn","parameters":{}}]}]
